t: This bronze statue shows General Sir Charles James Napier, and it stands on one of the four plinths in Trafalgar Square, the one to the southwest of Nelson's Column. It was made by the sculptor George Gammon Adams, who is best known for exactly this work. Napier fought in the Peninsular War and later led the British conquest of Sindh. He then served as its governor, and finally as Commander-in-Chief in India.
